cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before I tell you who won, which candidate were you hoping for?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You look disappointed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Ignore my face. It isn't your ballot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tell me your choice first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'd never know whether your kindness voted with me.

beats.text: Nice acceptance speech. I taught you to project, remember?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You taught me to order pizza when I was eight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And tonight an auditorium heard you. Progress.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I wrote the speech myself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Finally applying my lesson about not asking for help.

beats.text: Lovely portrait. You're finally getting the shadows I tried to teach you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My new teacher told me to stop mixing everything with black.

beats.text: Good. You're ready to move beyond my introductory method.

beats.speaker: B

beats.text: Excellent. You used to be far too sentimental. I was beginning to worry I'd never get you past that.

beats.speaker: B

beats.speaker: A

beats.speaker: A

cards.instruction: Describe defeat, penalty, or a bad bargain as a deliberate investment in a larger future win.
